review.management_type_reason: NC State・品種: 手間いらず、晩冬〜早春まで刈らない。Walters: 晩冬〜早春に10cmに刈る。NC State は稔る種子ができないとする。おぎはらの「姿が乱れたら」は決まった文。機械の B は根拠なし。試作例と同じ
review.management_type_quote: foliage and stems should not be cut back until late winter or early spring
review.heat_muggy_west_evidence:
[おぎはら/品種] 耐暑性；強
[MBG/品種] Tolerant of summer heat and humidity.
[NC State/品種] This plant prefers full sun, is tolerant of heat and drought tolerant once established, and adapts to most well-drained soils.
[RHS/品種] Aspect: South-facing or North-facing or West-facing or East-facing
review.spread_evidence:
[こぼれ種 0／NC State・品種] The cultivar, 'Morning Light,' does not produce viable seeds; therefore, its potential for invasiveness is significantly less.
[こぼれ種の食い違い] MBG は 1 相当、stauden.de は 1 相当
[地下茎 1／MBG・品種] Clumps slowly expand in circumference by short rhizomes, but typically retain tight clump shape.
review.mixing_evidence:
地下茎 0〜1（こぼれ種・地下茎の根拠の列）
[MBG・品種] This grass will reseed to the point of being somewhat aggressive, and is considered invasive in some areas.
